ORDER (Order of the Court was made by The Hon'ble Chief Justice)

In view of the Notification having been published by the State Government subsequent to the filing of the writ petition, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the writ petition and states that if the petitioner is interested, he would assail the statutory provision in accordance with law.
2. The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn in the aforesaid terms.
